sources.note: Neutrik NC3FXX dimension drawing ST-NC3FXX (opened, drawing rendered): overall length 71.5 - 73.5 mm, shell diameter 19.2 mm, mating front diameter 15.75 mm, latch lug on one side. The roughly 22 mm figure sometimes quoted does not hold for this connector: 19.2 mm is the shell, 24 mm is the panel cutout of the receptacle. What the model is: the CABLE-END female XLR (a loose plug on a cable, modelled on the Neutrik NC3FXX), not the panel receptacle. The catalog id xlr3-f matesWith xlr3-m, so it is the plug that goes onto an xlr3-m port such as the SM58 base: role = plug, outerMm = 15.75 mm, the front section that enters the male shell. The body is a revolved plug along +Z with the mating face at z = 0. 2026-11-04 (founder decision, after the reference research): the bounding box now includes the black bushing (about 20.3 mm, wider than the 19.2 mm metal shell, from one DXF parse of the Neutrik drawing) and the latch lug (top about 10.85 mm above the axis), so w = 20.3 and h = 21.0; the axis sits 0.35 mm below the box centre and the fix-up centres the box. The 19.2 mm shell and 15.75 mm front section stay as drawn. Length 72.5 mm = the middle of the 71.5 - 73.5 mm range.

Neutrik NC3MXX dimension drawing (opened, rendered): the male cable connector it mates with is 19 mm in diameter and 68.1 - 70.1 mm long; the 15.75 mm front section of the female goes inside the shell of the male.
Neutrik NC3FXX datasheet (opened): 3-pole female cable connector, cable O.D. 3.5 - 8.0 mm, IEC 61076-2-103.
